watch.en: Fresh pasta cooks very quickly, sometimes in seconds.
watch.de: Frische Nudeln garen sehr schnell, manchmal in Sekunden.

why.en: Fresh pasta is delicate, so it is cooked to order.
why.de: Frische Nudeln sind zart und werden deshalb erst auf Bestellung gekocht, also kurz vor dem Servieren.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 6.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Pasta Products
sources.sentence: Fresh pasta is so delicate and cooks so rapidly (sometimes in as little as 15 seconds) that it should be cooked to order.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 6.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Pasta Products
sources.sentence: The basic form is the sfoglia, a thin, flat sheet of dough that is cut into ribbons, circles or squares.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Cereal Doughs and Batters, Egg Pasta and Fresh Pasta, p. 574
sources.sentence: Fresh pasta cooks quickly, in a few seconds or minutes depending on thickness.

sources.place: Zubereiten einfacher Speisen - 4 Teigwaren - Nudeln und Strudel, 4.9 Nudeln kochen (margin note), p. 366
sources.sentence: Selbst gemachte Pasta fresca (frische Nudeln) auch.
